notes.title: NINJA KAMUI: SHINOBI ORIGINS Out Now!!
notes.content:
NINJA KAMUI: SHINOBI ORIGINS is now officially released!
A 25% launch discount will be applied for the first week of release (November 28 - December 5).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2586560/NINJA_KAMUI_SHINOBI_ORIGINS/
